reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Clear Toner 210ml
reviews.text:
My skin is sensitive and acne-prone, but I also struggle with visible pores, uneven texture and pigmentation, so finding a toner that feels effective without being too aggressive is not always easy.
I really like this toner because it feels fresh, light and comfortable on my skin. It absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave any heavy or sticky layer, which is very important for me because my skin does not react well to rich products. After using it, my skin feels smoother, refreshed and ready for the next steps of my routine.
I also appreciate that I can use it without feeling like I’m overwhelming my sensitive skin. So far, I’m very pleased with it.
reviews.zh:
我屬於敏感肌同容易生暗瘡嘅膚質，但同時都有毛孔明顯、膚質唔均勻同色斑嘅困擾，所以要搵一枝用得有效又唔會太刺激嘅爽膚水，從來都唔係易事。
我真係好鍾意呢枝爽膚水，因為用上面清爽、輕盈又舒服。佢吸收得好快，亦都唔會留低任何厚重或者黏笠嘅感覺，呢一點對我嚟講好重要，因為我嘅皮膚對滋潤型嘅產品反應都唔係太好。用完之後，我嘅皮膚摸落更滑、更清爽，亦都準備好迎接之後嘅護膚步驟。
我亦都好欣賞佢可以讓我安心使用，唔會覺得為敏感肌帶嚟負擔。暫時為止，我對佢非常滿意。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Clear Toner 210ml
reviews.text: This is a very light weight toner. It’s a little difficult to spread across the face and you definitely need a moisturizer immediately after using it, but it leaves your skin feeling clean and fresh!
reviews.zh: 呢枝爽膚水非常輕身。喺面上有少少難推開，而且用完之後一定要即刻搽保濕霜，不過佢會令你嘅皮膚感覺清爽乾淨！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Clear Toner 210ml
reviews.text: It has a beautiful, slippery-smooth texture that allows it to spread effortlessly. I apply it with my hands directly (3-4 pumps), but it also works well with a cotton pad for a gentle swipe. It absorbs incredibly quickly with zero stickiness, leaving an immediate cushion of hydration.
reviews.zh: 佢嘅質地滑溜順滑，好靚，可以輕鬆推開。我會直接用手上（3-4 泵），但用化妝棉輕輕一抹都一樣得。佢吸收得快到不得了，完全唔黏笠，即刻為皮膚補一層水潤。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Clear Toner 210ml
reviews.text: First toner that I really like, it doesn’t irritate and it’s perfect for any combination of products, I will order it again, I use it day and night and it last for a long period of time
reviews.zh: 第一枝我真心鍾意嘅爽膚水，唔刺激，仲可以配搭任何護膚品一齊用，我會再回購。我日頭夜晚都用，而且可以用好耐。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Clear Toner 210ml
reviews.text: Skin didn't agree with it. Made me break out and may have been too drying for me even though I have combination skin.
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚同佢夾唔嚟。用完之後爆咗瘡，雖然我係混合性膚質，但對我嚟講可能都太乾。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Clear Toner 210ml
reviews.text: I’ve been using this toner for a few weeks and it’s really good. It feels light and fresh on my skin, not sticky at all. My pores look smaller and my skin feels smoother. I really like it so far.
reviews.zh: 我已經用咗呢枝爽膚水幾個星期，真係好好用。搽上面感覺輕盈清爽，完全唔黏笠。毛孔睇落細咗，皮膚摸落更滑。暫時為止我真係好鍾意。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Clear Toner 210ml
reviews.text: I have been unhappy with my pores recently and this tonner made them shirnk and if used daily I can't see my pores anymore. Combine it with the same brands poremizing gel cream to see amazing results! Very happy with this product
reviews.zh: 我近排對自己嘅毛孔好唔滿意，呢枝爽膚水令我嘅毛孔收細咗，如果日日用嘅話，我已經睇唔到毛孔。配合同一個品牌嘅 Poremizing gel cream 一齊用，效果更加明顯！對呢件產品非常滿意

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Clear Toner 210ml
reviews.text:
I bought the SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Clear Toner a week and a half ago, and I have to say I’m impressed. I have oily skin (without acne tendencies), so I always look for products that help control shine without over-drying, and this toner has worked really well.

From the first few days, I noticed it leaves a fresh, lightweight feeling on my skin without any stickiness. With consistent use, my skin stays matte for longer throughout the day, especially in the T-zone. I’ve also seen some improvement in my skin texture and pore appearance, though it’s not an overnight miracle.

What I like the most is that it doesn’t irritate or leave my skin feeling tight, and since it doesn’t have a strong fragrance, it’s very pleasant to use. If you have oily skin and are looking for something that balances without being too harsh, I think this is worth trying. I’ll keep using it to see how my skin improves over time!
reviews.zh:
我喺一個半星期前買咗 SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Clear Toner，必須要講，我對佢印象深刻。我係油性肌（冇生暗瘡嘅傾向），所以一直都喺搵可以控油但又唔會過度抽乾嘅產品，呢枝爽膚水用落真係好有效。

頭幾日我已經留意到佢用完之後皮膚清爽輕盈，完全唔黏笠。持續用落去，皮膚成日都keep到霧面狀態更耐，尤其係 T 字位。我亦都見到膚質同毛孔有啲改善，雖然唔係一晚見效嘅奇蹟。

我最鍾意嘅係佢唔刺激，亦都唔會令皮膚繃緊，而且冇乜香味，用落非常舒服。如果你係油性肌，又想搵一枝平衡得好好但又唔會太刺激嘅產品，我覺得呢枝值得一試。我會繼續用落去，睇吓皮膚隨住時間有咩變化！
